strings.program_victory_prompt: You have lifted the curse of the cyan yoke!
strings.program_victory_message: The whole team is back. Do you want to save it before it's over?
strings.ending_page_1: And the spirit of Tironsex covered the body of the Tyrannex, and was struck by me. Had it not been for the Lodge, We would have taken your body and taken away your victory. But I could have escaped from the pool.
strings.ending_page_2: And when you reach out to the pool of light, he shouts, "Don't let the Hand of Moorende near it, you will release dangerous energy." Back off! When the Hand touches the pool, the pool shrinks, and the Hand will be shattered.
strings.ending_page_3: "I have no escape. You have done what the hosts could not do. So cheer, and today Tilunseks is falling." He is in vain before you.
strings.ending_page_4: And believe thou that he hath been destroyed, because thy last shackles have been cast down. And the curse of the garland has been removed from thee. Thou art free. And the knights of Ustrono came in: Congratulate ye that ye have defeated the Lord of the Fire. So let the might of Iminster take thee out of this place of desolation, and go unto a feast.
strings.ending_page_5: You were sent to the Shadow Valley, and the celebration began long ago. As soon as you arrived, the noise was thundering. Gary and Nakasiya held their hands and shouted from the stand, "You won!"
